deviations.what: The three home Buttons reset their sibling IconTabHeader again since 2026-08-05. The original reaches into the DOM (event.oSource.getParent().getDomRef()...) only to FIND that header - each button knows it statically here - and selectedKey is a BINDABLE property, so the reset is a bound value rather than a frontend action (the prefer-a-bindable-property rule, which the linter enforces): each header's selectedKey is two-way bound, the press round-trips and the backend writes 'invalidKey' back. The three headers keep that as their seeded value, as in the original view.

IconTabFilter interactionMode='SelectLeavesOnly' (property since 1.121) is kept 1:1 on the parent filters of the second ToolHeader's IconTabHeader (iconTabHeaderOneClickArea); requires a UI5 release >= 1.121.

IconTabFilter items (the nested sub-filter aggregation, since 1.77 per IconTabFilter.js JSDoc) is kept 1:1 in the second and third ToolHeaders' IconTabHeaders (nested User/Identity/Monitoring filters); requires a UI5 release >= 1.77. Aggregation-level member, invisible to the property gate (it scans attributes only) - declared by policy, found in review 2026-07-27.

Fully static view reproduced 1:1: three tnt:ToolHeaders, each with a home Button, an IconTabHeader (mode='Inline', backgroundDesign='Transparent', selectedKey='invalidKey') with OverflowToolbarLayoutData, search/comment Buttons and a MenuButton with a Menu (Edit/Save). The second/third ToolHeaders use nested IconTabFilter items; no bound data.
